title: Pricing and Policy Updates FAQs — Xero Developer
snippet:
- On 4-December, Xero announced [new pricing and policies](/pricing).
- Designed to meet developers where they are in their app development journey, we are transitioning to five tiers: Starter, Core, Plus, Advanced, Enterprise based on connections and data consumption via the Xero APIs. This change will make it easier to move through the tiers and access benefits as you grow and scale, while also making it clearer for developers to forecast and control their pricing. Changes to app tiers and pricing model changes will take effect on 2 March, 2026.

Beginning on 2 March, 2026, we will be moving to a commercial tiering model based on connections and Xero API usage. Xero will no longer be pricing based on a revenue-share model

| Feature | Starter | Core | Plus | Advanced | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Connections (maximum) | 5 | 50 | 1000 | 10,000 | No limit |
| Monthly Tier Fee | No charge | $35 AUD | $245 AUD | $1445 AUD | Price on Application |
| Monthly Xero API usage (Ingress GBs) | Unlimited | Unlimited | Unlimited | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| Monthly Xero API usage (Egress GBs)* | n/a | 10 GBs | 50 GBs | 250 GBs | Volume on Application |
| Overage Xero API usage egress pricing (per GB) | n/a | $2.40 AUD | $2.40 AUD | $2.40 AUD | Price on Application |

New apps created in the Xero Developer portal will default to the Starter tier. The Starter tier has unlimited data access to enable early innovation but is capped at 5 connections. In order to add a 6th connection, you will need to first add your payment details. Once that is complete, you will move to the Core tier.
In order to move beyond the Core tier and access additional tier benefits, you will need to meet tier requirements. Beginning 2 March, 2026, you can apply to move between tiers within the developer portal.

### 24. How do I move between tiers?
New apps created in the Xero Developer portal will default to the Starter tier. The Starter tier has unlimited data access to enable early innovation but is capped at 5 connections. In order to add a 6th connection, you will need to first add your payment details. Once that is complete, you will move to the Core tier.
In order to move beyond the Core tier and access additional tier benefits, you will need to meet tier requirements. Beginning 2 March, 2026, you can apply to move between tiers within the developer portal.

Rate limits are the same as Xero APIs. Today that's 1,000 calls per day per organisation on the Starter plan and 5,000 per day per organisation on the Core plan and above, per the [pricing page](https://developer.xero.com/pricing).

title: Pricing — Xero Developer
snippet:
- **Clear, usage based pricing:** Designed to meet developers where they are in their app development journey, we are retiring our current revenue share model (comprising Xero App Store Subscriptions and Commercial Billing) and introducing five plans: Starter, Core, Plus, Advanced, Enterprise. These plans are based on connections and data egress volume via the Xero APIs, making it easier to access benefits as you grow and scale, while also making it clearer for you to forecast and control costs. App plans and pricing model changes will take effect on 2 March, 2026.

Plans have been created to enable early innovation and create an accessible entry point for developers just getting started. As your app scales, requiring additional benefits, you can easily move through the plans.

title: How Xero Developer changes affect your practice
snippet:
From 2 March 2026, Xero Developer is changing from a revenue-share model to a tiered usage-based pricing model. Pricing will largely be based on the number of Xero customers connected to an app and the amount of data the app extracts from Xero.
To support innovation in our app ecosystem, the entry-level Starter tier will remain free. This keeps barriers to entry low so developers and startups can continue to build new solutions for practices.

In addition to the custom integrations built specifically for your practice or single client use, many tools for managing practices and clients are excluded from the new pricing model. These include:
- Data conversion apps
- Financial services apps including bank feeds, credit integrations and third-party payment partnerships
### Will this affect the price of apps?
Our new pricing model is based on a fair value exchange for data, where developers pay for the data and connections they use.
For the majority of developers, their pricing will remain the same or decrease. We’re working with developers with high-consumption apps to optimise their data usage.
